### Log Jam — G4 background pony (fan name)

**Who he is:** A blue-gray unicorn stallion from Starlight Glimmer’s former “equal” village in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for his dark navy mane and tail, light-green eyes, and unsettling forced smile while he wears the village’s equal-sign cutie mark. His own cutie mark depicts **a log and a hand saw**. The [unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) identifies his design and appearances.

**Naming:** “Log Jam” is an **unofficial fan/community name**, not a verified name spoken in the series or credited by Hasbro. A Derpibooru screenshot posted by **ApplejackFan204 on October 25, 2016** says “I dub thee… Log Jam.” That establishes a documented fan naming moment, not necessarily the first-ever use.

**Appearances and voice:** Background appearances in **“The Cutie Map” Parts 1–2** (season 5) and **“To Where and Back Again” Parts 1–2** (season 6). No individual spoken line or voice-actor credit was verified. The [earth-pony index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) also catalogs an earth-pony rendering in S6E25; no plot-related transformation or separate identity is established.

**Verified show stills** (original animation by the *Friendship Is Magic* production team; the named users below posted/archived screenshots, rather than drawing the original frames):

- **Equalized appearance, season 5:** [![Log Jam with an equal-sign cutie mark](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/20/876229/full.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/876229) — Derpibooru screencap dated April 17, 2015; original uploader not stated in the archive; mirrored by `booruimporter`.
- **Close-up and the fan-name caption, season 6:** [![Log Jam close-up](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/20/1281186/full.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/1281186) — originally posted by **ApplejackFan204** on October 25, 2016; mirrored by `booruimporter`. The image is a show still, not original artwork by that uploader.

No independently attributable original fan illustration was verified.
